country_snapshot: The project mobilised and trained 133 women EHRDs and CSO representatives and operationalized a Fast Response Mechanism for women defenders. It also supported NCVAW to adopt eMonitor+ for monitoring online violence.

The project conducted a rapid assessment of 100 CSOs and EHRDs and delivered a four-day capacity-building programme for 32 women activists. It completed two sub-national policy dialogues that led to a formal Cooperation MoU, and used eMonitor+ digital monitoring to track online violence.

The project completed policy mapping of national and county frameworks for women environmental defenders and delivered capacity-building to 40 defenders across 17 organizations. It also trained 2 WED monitors and 4 partner staff on eMonitor+.

The project established engagement with 10 women-led CSOs and completed a Policy Analysis and Capacity Assessment on WEHRDs. Digital monitoring using eMonitor+ generated evidence on TFGBV trends to support advocacy and protection.

The project strengthened advocacy capacities for 237 women from women-led CSOs and established two EHRD networks, two Communities of Practice and two Climate Action Groups. It supported FIDA to develop a Climate Justice Toolkit, and trained CSO partner monitors on eMonitor+ to strengthen the evidence base on TFGBV.
